newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended steady at 41.90 to the dollar in the kerb market on Tuesday amid dull demand for the U.S. currency, dealers said.
One dealer said the rupee was likely to open stable on Wednesday.
The State (central) bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on the foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 4.70 percent. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
